## The Pocket Briefing

Every 15 minutes this workflow checks your Google Calendar for meetings starting in 30 to 45 minutes. For each one it:
1. Extracts the guest (first attendee who is not you)
2. Looks them up in your CRM sheet (who they are, company, how they found you, notes)
3. Pulls the last 5 emails with them from Gmail
4. Sends one Telegram brief to your phone

Every call opens sharp. Zero prep time.

The 15-minute poll + 30-45 minute window means each meeting gets exactly ONE brief, about half an hour before it starts.

Before first run: credentials + env vars (see README) and set this workflow as its own Error Workflow.

### SWAP POINT 1: Calendar

Demo = Google Calendar (calendar id from env, "primary" = your main calendar).

Swap for Outlook Calendar (Microsoft Outlook node, Get Many events with the same 30-45 min window) or Calendly (webhook at booking time instead of polling).

No meetings in the window = flow ends quietly. No spam.

### SWAP POINT 2: CRM

Demo = Google Sheets "Leads" tab (name, email, company, source, notes), matched by the guest's email.

Swap for HubSpot (Search Contact by email) or Pipedrive (Search Persons). Map to the same 5 fields.

Unknown guest? The brief still sends, marked as not in the CRM.

### SWAP POINT 3: Email history

Demo = Gmail search, last 5 messages to or from the guest.

Swap for Microsoft Outlook (Get Many messages with a search filter) or your CRM's email timeline. No history = the brief says so instead of breaking.

### SWAP POINT 4: Where the brief lands

Demo = Telegram (lands on the rep's phone).

Swap for Slack DM (Slack node, send to user), SMS via Twilio, or email. The finished brief text is in {{ $json.text }}.

### Failure alert

Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow (Settings > Error Workflow > The Pocket Briefing) or this never fires.
